title: Vishnu Purana
author: vyasa
attributionNote: Traditionally attributed to Vyasa. The Purana is a composite work shaped over centuries; the attribution is traditional rather than documentary.
description: One of the eighteen Mahapuranas and a foundational Vaishnava text. Its six parts treat creation, cosmology, genealogy, the Manus, the duties of the castes and orders of life, and the life of Krishna. Dutt's prose translation, based principally on Wilson's earlier version, is complete in this edition.
historicalContext: A relatively early Purana, dated by scholars to the fourth or fifth century CE. H. H. Wilson's 1840 translation was the first English version; Dutt's 1894–96 rendering modernised and completed it for a general readership.
availabilityNote: Streamed from Project Gutenberg at read time. The six parts and 250 sections are complete for this translation; section titles are those printed in the edition.
